messages:
Noah: noticing a sudden 503 spike for apiserver in us-west2 around 09:12 UTC
Noah: apiserver_5xx_rate jumped from ~0.1 -> 3.8, proxy_fd_util reported at 96%
Maria: any recent onboarding or infra churn?
Kevin: provisioner shows a sharp onboarding wave 09:05-09:08 — ~130 GPU nodes booting
Ophelia: that many kubelets will hammer control plane for certs and probes -> NAT ephemeral exhaustion and conntrack thrash
Noah: etcd logs show leader change at 09:13 and again at 09:15; controller-manager OOMKilled once
Noah: quick tail:
Noah: ```
E0411 09:13:15 apiserver: 503 GET /api/v1/pods?limit=500 (timeout)
W0411 09:13:16 etcdserver: leader transfer requested, term=57
E0411 09:13:18 controller-manager: panic: failed to list services: rpc error: code = Unavailable
```
Maria: can someone run conntrack count on nat-gw? `conntrack -L | wc -l` and `sysctl net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range`
Kevin: nat-gw reports 64780 conntrack entries, nf_conntrack_max=65536, ip_local_port_range 32768-61000
Ophelia: proxies hitting fd limit-> they start dropping accepts -> clients retry -> more ephemeral ports used -> spiral
Maria: mitigation plan: 1) pause provisioning 2) bump conntrack and fd limits 3) widen ip_local_port_range 4) reduce kubelet probe frequency for new nodes
Kevin: paused the provisioner (patch applied) :white_check_mark:
Maria: running quick fixes:
Maria: ```
sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144
sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range='10240 60999'
systemctl set-property kube-proxy.service TasksMax=200000
```
Ophelia: also lowering kubelet probe chatter for nodes in onboarding group (initialDelay -> 30s, period->30s)
Noah: deploy-bot: created INC-2021: apiserver 503s - us-west2
Kevin: short-term routing idea: spin a small quarantined apiserver replica set and route new-node registrations there (taint + toleration)
Maria: queued runbook steps and rollback commands; updating monitoring alerts for proxy_fd_util > 85% and conntrack_util > 80%
Ophelia: 10:25 UTC - after sysctl and fd bump, 5xx rate trending down, etcd leader stable for 8m, controller-manager restarts stopped
Kevin: 10:32 UTC - re-enabled onboarding but with strict limit 8 nodes/min and target apiserver quarantine pool
Maria: follow-ups: (a) add conntrack autoscaler & reclaim rules, (b) add onboarding rate limiter to provisioner with backpressure, (c) cost assessment for slower ramps (reserved GPU lease exposure)
Noah: priority was stability; we accepted brief onboarding slowdown to avoid controlplane thrash — finance/ops will evaluate cost impact
infra-bot: action logged: provisioner paused by Kevin; quarantine apiserver replicas requested by Noah
Noah: will close incident after 30m stable. Thanks for the quick coordination everyone :thumbsup:
